headlines.title: DoorDash Stock Falls as It Buys Grubhub Campus Dining
headlines.summary: Grubhub Campus Dining runs at more than 450 colleges and universities

headlines.title: Wonder scores a $425 million partnership with DoorDash as it builds its food empire
headlines.summary: Founded by veteran e-commerce entrepreneur Marc Lore, Wonder is slowly building a massive portfolio of restaurants and delivery companies.

headlines.title: DoorDash invests $125M in Wonder as part of strategic partnership
headlines.summary: The delivery company is also acquiring Grubhub’s campus dining business from Wonder for $300 million.

headlines.title: DoorDash and Wonder Announce Strategic Partnership
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO & NEW YORK, September 15, 2026--DoorDash, a global leader in local commerce, and Wonder, a leading food technology platform, today announced a strategic partnership. Under the agreement, DoorDash will acquire Wonder's Grubhub Campus Dining business. In addition, DoorDash made a long-term investment in Wonder as part of its Series D round.

headlines.title: DoorDash buys Grubhub campus unit for $300M
headlines.summary: DoorDash will continue to expand Grubhub’s former campus dining operations, and Wonder will use money from the deal and an investment to sustain growth.

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
